stem: What is the significance of this 1978 mural?

options.label: F
options.text: It is representative of artistic expressions of the Beat Generation.

options.label: G
options.text: It was commissioned by the federal government through the National Endowment for the Arts (NEA).

options.label: H
options.text: It is an example of cultural pride among Mexican Americans.

options.label: J
options.text: It was painted by artists employed under the Works Progress Administration (WPA).

visual_elements: Black-and-white photo of a mural on a concrete support, featuring images of people, a snake coiled around a tree trunk, an eagle, and architectural elements.
